text: A digital signature scheme for messages in {0, 1}∗ is a tuple of polynomial-time algorithms SIG = (Gen, Sign, Verify) with the following syntax. • Gen(1λ ) outputs a signing key sk and a verification key vk. • Sign(sk, m) outputs a signature σ on a message m. • Verify(vk, m, σ) deterministically outputs a bit indicating whether σ is a valid signature on m under vk. The scheme SIG is a digital signature scheme with unforgeability error εsig relative to an oracle O if the following hold. • Perfect correctness. For every λ ∈ N, every (sk, vk) ∈ Supp(Gen(1λ )), and every message m, Pr [ Verify(vk, m, σ) = 1 | σ ← Sign(sk, m) ] = 1 .
